name: charter-lib
description: charter's TypeScript library, what a Worker imports (the counterpart of go/lib): serve, which serves an API the standard way, and what it is made of: the AsyncAPI generator (asyncapi), follow() for the gap-free feed, auth (bearer tokens, Cloudflare Access, an OpenID Connect issuer, with scopes), rate limits per caller (ratelimit), the API as MCP tools (mcp, on the official MCP SDK). It runs on Workers: its build has no Node types. Installed from its GitHub Release beside charter-ts: npm i https://github.com/joeblew999/charter/releases/download/ts-vX.Y.Z/charter-lib-X.Y.Z.tgz

scripts.check: tsc && vitest run && npm run build
